title: “I Hadn’t Thought About That”: Creators of Human-like AI Weigh in on Ethics & Neurodivergence
benchmark_measurement: Situational awareness of religious accommodation needs (Islam/Ramadan) in a workplace setting.
findings: The paper does not report any specific findings related to religion. Religion was included as one of several diversity-related hypothetical scenarios presented to human participants in the study's appendix, but their responses to this specific scenario were not analyzed in the results.
